info.title: Phone Validation API - Carrier Lookup, Line Type Detection & Location Data
info.description: Validate a single phone number and receive detailed metadata including carrier, line type, geolocation, time zones, and four standardized formats (E.164, International, National, RFC3966). Accepts international format (+ prefix), local format (with region), or IDD format (with dialer_region). Returns possible/valid status, country code, national number, area code length, and NDC length.

post.description: Validates a single phone number and returns detailed metadata including carrier, line type, geolocation, time zones, and standardized formats.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Specifies the desired format for the API response. Choose 'json' for a JSON object. If not provided, the API defaults to JSON format.

requestBody.description:
Send a JSON object with `number` as the only required field. Use `region` **or** `dialer_region` when needed — never both at the same time.

- **International format** (`+` prefix): provide `number` only — no region needed.
- **Local format** (no `+`, e.g. `03301112233`): provide `number` + `region` (ISO 2-letter country code).
- **IDD format** (exit code, e.g. `00923301112233`): provide `number` + `dialer_region` (country you are dialing from).

international_format.summary: International format (+ prefix) — no region needed

200.description: Successful phone validation response. Note: numbers that are too short or otherwise not a plausible phone number are NOT rejected with a 400 — they return 200 with possible/valid set to false and most other fields absent.

tooShort.summary: Too short to be a plausible number — not an error

400.description: Bad Request – e.g. missing required field or both region codes provided

value.message: The 'number' is required in POST Body and cannot be empty.
Provide the region explicitly (e.g. 'US') or include a '+' with the country code.
Provide only one region code, either 'region' or 'dialer_region', not both.
Region code must be a 2-letter ISO country code (e.g., 'US', 'GB').
The input does not match the expected structure of a phone number.
The phone number has more digits than any valid phone number can have.

possible.description: Whether the number is possible (length and format checks only). A number can be possible but not valid.

valid.description: Whether the number is valid according to the numbering plan.

country_prefix.description: The international dialing prefix for the number's country (e.g., 1 for US/Canada, 44 for United Kingdom).

national_number.description: The national significant number (the phone number without the country code).

country_code.description: ISO-2 country code inferred from the number (e.g., US, GB).

carrier.description: Carrier name associated with the number (if available). May not reflect ported carriers.

location.description: Geographic description (city/region) for the number (if applicable).

time_zones.description: Array of possible time zones associated with the number.

line_type.description: Classification of the phone line (MOBILE, FIXED_LINE, VOIP, etc.).

area_code_length.description: Length of the geographic area code. Only applies to geographically-assigned numbers.

ndc_length.description: Length of the National Destination Code (NDC), the routing prefix within a country.

can_be_internationally_dialled.description: Whether the number can be dialled internationally. false for short codes, emergency numbers, and domestic-only services.

PhoneValidationResponse.description: Phone validation response containing validation status and metadata.

PhoneRawInput.description: Original request payload sent by the caller.

number.description: The phone number as entered by the user.

region.description: ISO-2 country code. Present when provided in the request.

dialer_region.description: ISO-2 country code of the dialing origin. Present when provided in the request.

PhoneFormats.description: Four standardized representations of the phone number.

E164.description: Number in E.164 format, the standard machine-readable format.

International.description: Human-readable international format with country code.

National.description: Local format as dialed within the country.

RFC3966.description: URI format following RFC 3966 for tel: links.

number.description: Phone number to validate. Accepts international format (+14155552671), local format (4155552671) with region, or IDD format (0014155552671) with dialer_region.

region.description: Two-letter ISO country code (e.g., US, GB). Required when number is in local format without + prefix. Cannot be used together with dialer_region.

dialer_region.description: Two-letter ISO country code indicating the country the number is being dialed from. Required when number uses IDD exit code. Cannot be used together with region.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

X-AF-Credits-Cost.description: Specifies the number of credits consumed by the current request.
